title: Financial Instruments: Disclosures
summary: Prescribes the disclosure requirements for financial instruments, substantively identical to IFRS 7, with the most significant Indian-specific context being interaction with RBI's prudential disclosure requirements for banks and NBFCs.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Closely Converged with IFRS 7
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 107 is substantively identical to IFRS 7, with the most significant Indian-specific context being its interaction with RBI's own prudential disclosure requirements for banks and NBFCs. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
